d:
This is actually a combination of two different doujinshi by the same author. Starting on page 8, I made the mistake of using pages with slightly lower scan quality. I might correct this later; for now, this is what I have so far.

I used some AI tools to remove the censorship, although I had to practically redraw the female genitalia from scratch. The cover and back cover illustrations had mosaic censorship, so I had to use a lot of imagination to figure out what the complete illustration would look like without it. It's not perfect, but overall I think it's acceptable.

Update: I've finally replaced the lower-quality parts with much better ones. I've also added some more pages and illustrations. I wanted to focus solely on the futanari aspect, so I've omitted any male characters. To do this, I modified one page to use as a transition. I also changed an illustration that contained scat; instead, I tried to make it look like there's a tentacle.
n: [Doujinshi] (C60) [prettydolls (Araki Hiroaki, Fukami Naoyuki)] PULP Atarashii Nakoruru Kyoukasho (Samurai Spirits) (Decensored)
